name: hustlebot
description: Cross-session goal loop for Claude Code: /hustle orchestrates planning, setup and ignition of a self-scheduling chain that works one verified increment per headless run, parking at subscription limits and resuming on reset. Two modes: plan mode executes a grilled GOAL.md then stops; charter mode runs a self-directed PO+Dev loop against a Plane backlog (Planner invents work, Executor builds it) until a feature-freeze date or manual abort. Includes a zero-token web monitor with an animated status avatar.
